decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today — NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.3% — with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding dry powder rather than forcing a partial buy, and letting existing positions ride.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ (-0.8%) and S&P 500 (-0.3%) drifted lower today in a mild, broad-based pullback rather than a sharp selloff tied to any single catalyst. Trading stayed range-bound with no strong sector leadership, typical of a consolidation day after recent gains. Without a clear directional signal, this looks more like routine profit-taking and repositioning than the start of a deeper correction.
market_education.summary_zh: 納指今日下跌0.8%，標普500下跌0.3%，屬溫和且普遍性的回調，並非由單一重大事件觸發的急挫。大市維持區間震盪，未見明顯板塊領漲，較似近期升勢過後的整固日。在缺乏明確方向訊號下，今日走勢更像是例行獲利回吐及倉位調整，而非深度調整的開端。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears, rather than being invested just for the sake of staying fully invested. Today's cash balance was below our buy threshold and the market showed no strong risk-on signal, so holding that cash in reserve is the disciplined choice.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是暫時持有的現金儲備，留待真正吸引的投資機會出現時才動用，而非為了「滿倉」而勉強買入。今日現金水平未達買入門檻，市況亦未見明確的風險偏好訊號，因此保留現金儲備才是有紀律的做法。
